text:
A teacher makes the statement, ‘Object P has a higher thermal capacity than object Q.’
What does this statement mean?
A
Object P has a higher melting point than object Q.
B
Object P has a lower melting point than object Q.
C
The increase in temperature of object P is greater than that of object Q for the same increase
in internal energy.
D
The increase in temperature of object P is smaller than that of object Q for the same increase
in internal energy.
